method: Reproduced from the two three-point orbits in the published Albrecht–Collatz rule; barycentric coordinates mapped to the atlas reference triangle, weights scaled to area 1/2.
author: J. Albrecht, L. Collatz
source: J. Albrecht, L. Collatz: Zur numerischen Auswertung mehrdimensionaler Integrale. ZAMM 38 (1958), 1–15. https://doi.org/10.1002/zamm.19580380102
